text: Barnaby Lott, auctioneer! Going once, going twice... oh, you're just looking. Wonderful!
Lots on the board, captain! Something for everyone and everyone for something!
The Kingsport auction house! Where the Reach sells what it shouldn't have and buys what it can't afford!
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Up with the gulls, I see.
Hold the item up and name your price: '/auction sell' and a number of doubloons. It goes straight on the board.
If it sells while you're at sea, I keep your takings safe. Five percent to the house, naturally.
Legendary blades go for a fortune. Ship deeds too. Golden marlin, if anyone ever catches one again.
Rare flags! Collectors pay through the nose for a Kraken's Coil.
